newsitem.title: USA: ChatCom sees June quarter loss.
newsitem.headline: ChatCom sees June quarter loss.

text.p: ChatCom Inc, a provider of application and communication computer servers, expects to report a loss for the quarter ending June 30, on revenues ranging from $4.25 to $4.4 million.
Chatcom lost $0.08 a share on sales of $2.7 million in the fiscal first quarter ended June 30, 1996. It lost $0.23 a share on $1.5 million of sales in the quarter ended March 31.
In a statement issued late Monday, ChatCom said higher operating costs would lead to a lower-than-expected gross margin for the June quarter, which would likely cause a loss.
ChatCom said it needed more liquidity to support its current operations. It is seeking financing to meet immediate needs and those for the balance of the current fiscal year.
On a positive note, the company has experienced higher demand for server consolidation, network emulation and telephone company Internet services since March 31.
It is continuing to refocus products and change its customer base. To increase gross profit margins, it has begun to implement measures to reduce its operating expenses.
